# Solar Hijri Calendar Component

Project goal: professional Solar Hijri / Jalali calendar primitives and frontend components across React, Web Components, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and related frontend stacks.

Current implementation summary on 2026-08-26:

- React inline calendar component in ./src/SolarHijriCalendar.tsx.
- React multiple-date calendar component in ./src/SolarHijriMultipleCalendar.tsx.
- React range calendar component in ./src/SolarHijriRangeCalendar.tsx.
- Date math and grid generation in ./src/calendarMath.ts.
- Runtime date, month, and range validation in ./src/validation.ts.
- Date bounds and disabled matcher composition in ./src/constraints.ts.
- Range, multiple selection, and matcher helpers in ./src/selection.ts.
- Public types in ./src/types.ts.
- Locale labels in ./src/labels.ts.
- Styles in ./src/styles.css.
- Unit tests in ./src/calendarMath.test.ts, ./src/constraints.test.ts,
  ./src/labels.test.ts, ./src/selection.test.ts, and ./src/validation.test.ts.
- Interactive React testing lab in ./playground/react, deployed at https://moroshani.github.io/solar-hijri-calendar-component/.
- Explicit lab month/year selectors exercise the controlled month API.
- Playwright viewport QA in ./tests/playwright: 25 interaction checks and 5 responsive screenshot checks in the current gate.
- v0.1.1 is published on npm and GitHub from annotated tag v0.1.1 at commit
  644085f. The package URL is
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/solar-hijri-calendar-component/v/0.1.1.
- CI, CodeQL, and Demo are green on tagged commit 644085f. Exact-tag and clean
  npm registry-consumer verification passed on 2026-08-26.
- The npm package is bound to .github/workflows/publish.yml as a GitHub Actions
  Trusted Publisher. Future v* tags run the full release gate and publish via
  OIDC without a stored npm token.
- CORE-101 is complete in PR #3. Validation predicates
  return false for invalid unknown values; other public date/month/range entry
  points throw RangeError for invalid supplied values. Supported years are
  -61 through 3176. The focused suite passes 48 tests, and a clean tarball
  consumer passes ESM, CommonJS, strict TypeScript NodeNext, React SSR, core,
  and CSS checks.
- CORE-102 is active on core/arithmetic-and-bounds. It adds exact week movement,
  clamping year movement, deterministic earlier/later helpers, and inclusive
  bound/clamp primitives. The full unit suite now contains 53 tests. The
  published package and GitHub release remain at v0.1.1; no 0.2.0 release
  exists yet.

Agent notes:

- Prefer source-controlled docs over chat-only decisions.
- Keep docs updated with API, packaging, and architecture changes.
- Use ./docs/implementation-plan.md as the execution source of truth and update
  its handoff record when work starts or finishes.
- Prefer codebase-memory-mcp graph tools for code discovery when available.
- Run lint, tests, and build after code changes.
- Run npm package inspection before release and exclude tests from declaration output.
